-The consumer validates each complete ledger envelope before grouped persistence; an invalid row rejects its whole envelope without blocking valid siblings. Other explicit versions, malformed/empty sets, invalid explicit delivery IDs and caller-supplied reserved provenance are rejected, never partially filtered. Its ordered per-envelope `ack`/`retry` dispositions control queue acknowledgement; missing dispositions retry. `ok` is false if any envelope retries, and `skipped` counts rejected envelopes, not acknowledged drops or individual rows. Successful erasure suppression can acknowledge. Shared storage/barrier/capture failure retries the admitted cohort because aggregate partial counts do not prove individual completion. This does not add quarantine/DLQ or prevent retry exhaustion; legacy partial writes can still duplicate. A completely removed managed ID is indistinguishable from legitimate legacy input. Fan-out/statistics and producer activation are unchanged.
+The consumer validates each complete ledger envelope before grouped persistence; an invalid row rejects its whole envelope without blocking valid siblings. Unversioned and `version:1` legacy messages without a delivery ID remain supported. Other explicit versions, malformed/empty sets, invalid explicit delivery IDs and caller-supplied reserved provenance are rejected, never partially filtered. Its ordered per-envelope `ack`/`retry` dispositions control queue acknowledgement; missing dispositions retry. `ok` is false if any envelope retries, and `skipped` counts rejected envelopes, not acknowledged drops or individual rows. Successful erasure suppression can acknowledge. Shared storage/barrier/capture failure retries the admitted cohort because aggregate partial counts do not prove individual completion. This does not add quarantine/DLQ or prevent retry exhaustion; legacy partial writes can still duplicate. A completely removed managed ID is indistinguishable from legitimate legacy input. Producer activation remains separate.
 
+Online learning now checks HTTP success and versioned, count-conserving application receipts, including the ring-to-statistics credit cascade. Statistics `processed` counts existing accumulator calls whose save was acknowledged; `skipped` counts rows the existing handler did not process. Alarm scheduling is reported separately and does not prove lift publication. A failed mutation/save invalidates cached state; missing, failed or malformed acknowledgements mean unknown or not-attempted work, never a safe automatic retry. Ring receipts keep attributed credits separate from weighted eligible credits and downstream processing; append acceptance is separate from cutoff suppression and the resulting bounded ring/index depths. Current background decision/outcome callers emit one fixed numeric incomplete summary without identifiers, payloads or raw errors. Downstream waits do not hold the ring's read lock or delay the shopper response. This is handler acknowledgement, not unique-event accounting, durable reconciliation/recovery, an atomic erasure fence or publication/completeness assurance; non-idempotent exposure/credit writes are not retried.
+
 ## 3. Identity
 
 All under `/v1/{tenant}/identity/`. The first two take the site key; the rest take the operator token.
